question: Two trains A and B are 155 km apart on a straight line. One train starts from A at 7:00 A.M. and travels towards B at 20 km/h. Another train starts from B at 8:00 A.M. and travels towards A at a speed of 25 km/h. At what time will they meet?
solution:

Distance between A and B = 155 km

Speed of Train from A (Sa) = 20 km/h

Speed of Train from B (Sb) = 25 km/h

Train B starts one hour later than Train A.

**Concept: **
